_comment: INTERVIEWS & REVIEWS. Two shelves, deliberately unequal. `quotes` is small and loud — two or three lines that do the persuading, set large. `clippings` is the wall: everything else, dense, scannable, the thing that makes a personal site read as vouched-for rather than self-declared.
_comment_nav: While BOTH arrays are empty the /press/ page still builds but is NOT linked from the masthead — an empty press page is worse than no press page. Add a real entry and the nav link appears on its own. Nothing to wire up.

_example_quote.text: The one sentence worth reprinting. Trim it hard — a pull-quote that needs three clauses is not a pull-quote.

_example_clipping.title: Strati: quando il crime incontra l'archeologia nasce un podcast

_comment_kind: `kind` is one of Interview, Review, Feature. It renders as a chip. Keep it to those three — a fourth category makes the wall stop scanning.
